name: Inu Neko Bloomers
source:
■ Inumimi + Nekomimi + Buruma ADV game.
The main character ends up living with two cute dog and cat girls who suddenly tumble in.
Let's have the two people who want milk lick it a lot!
■This is a crazy love comedy featuring many perverted characters! The character's facial expressions change often so you won't get bored!
